NARRATOR.say: in a deep, warm, reverent cinematic documentary narrator voice, slow and measured

lines.text: Midnight. A violent storm rages over the Sea of Galilee.
Then, through the wind and the waves, a figure comes walking upon the water.
The disciples cry out in fear. But He says: Be of good cheer; it is I; be not afraid.
Peter steps out of the boat and walks toward Jesus. But when he sees the wind, he begins to sink.
Immediately, Jesus stretches out His hand, and catches him.
